## Stainless Steel - Specific Heat and Thermal Conductivities vs. Temperatures

This tool provides specific heat capacity (c) and thermal conductivity (k) values for stainless steel at different temperatures.

**Note:** Values are interpolated from the reference table. For accurate results, use temperatures within the range of 100-1500 K.

outputs.label: Specific Heat Capacity (c)
outputs.formula: inputs.temperature < 100 ? 0.272 : inputs.temperature < 200 ? 0.272 + (inputs.temperature - 100) * (0.402 - 0.272) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 300 ? 0.402 + (inputs.temperature - 200) * (0.477 - 0.402) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 400 ? 0.477 + (inputs.temperature - 300) * (0.515 - 0.477) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 600 ? 0.515 + (inputs.temperature - 400) * (0.557 - 0.515) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 800 ? 0.557 + (inputs.temperature - 600) * (0.582 - 0.557) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1000 ? 0.582 + (inputs.temperature - 800) * (0.611 - 0.582) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1200 ? 0.611 + (inputs.temperature - 1000) * (0.640 - 0.611) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1500 ? 0.640 + (inputs.temperature - 1200) * (0.682 - 0.640) / 300 : 0.682

outputs.label: Thermal Conductivity (k)
outputs.formula: inputs.temperature < 100 ? 9.2 : inputs.temperature < 200 ? 9.2 + (inputs.temperature - 100) * (12.6 - 9.2) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 300 ? 12.6 + (inputs.temperature - 200) * (14.9 - 12.6) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 400 ? 14.9 + (inputs.temperature - 300) * (16.6 - 14.9) / 100 : inputs.temperature < 600 ? 16.6 + (inputs.temperature - 400) * (19.8 - 16.6) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 800 ? 19.8 + (inputs.temperature - 600) * (22.6 - 19.8) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1000 ? 22.6 + (inputs.temperature - 800) * (25.4 - 22.6) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1200 ? 25.4 + (inputs.temperature - 1000) * (28.0 - 25.4) / 200 : inputs.temperature < 1500 ? 28.0 + (inputs.temperature - 1200) * (31.7 - 28.0) / 300 : 31.7
